tagline: Building With Purpose. Built To Last.

theme_strategy.primary_surface: Light Warm White background for marketing story pages; Deep Charcoal Black surface for architectural contrast cards & Admin Dashboard
theme_strategy.visual_ratio: 60% Warm White (#F7F5F0) / 25% Charcoal-Graphite (#171A1C, #252A2D) / 10% Architectural Stone (#E9E4DA) / 5% Luxury Copper-Bronze (#B77A45)

rules: Never use safety yellow or dominant high-vis orange
Copper/Bronze #B77A45 is reserved strictly for high-value interactive accents (~5%), hover states, focal badge highlights, and active step markers
Use #F7F5F0 for primary marketing surfaces, seamlessly offset by #E9E4DA section blocks and #171A1C hero/footer monolithic cards
Ensure minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for body copy and 3:1 for display headings across light and dark cards

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-snug

rules: Never use Inter for main section headings or H1; use Manrope or Plus Jakarta Sans with negative letter-spacing
Incorporate Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display selectively for quote blocks, luxury project captions, and numbered manifesto headers (e.g. '01. Structural Integrity')
Overlines must always be uppercase with letter-spacing tracking-[0.2em] or tracking-[0.25em]

spacing_and_layout.system: Generous architectural grid with explicit asymmetry and negative space

grid_modes.tetris_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12

rules: Containers with explicit borders MUST have internal padding of minimum p-6 or p-8 to eliminate text-border collisions
Grid elements must be direct children of the layout wrapper
Mobile images must respect max-h-[80vh] to preserve layout balance on small screens

libraries: framer-motion (Staggered reveals, kinetic masked text reveals, tab transitions)
three / @react-three/fiber / @react-three/drei (Interactive architectural 3D stone monolith hero scene)
3d_and_motion.hero_3d_concept: A floating architectural stone geometry with metallic copper vein reflections that rotates dynamically on mouse drift and responds to scroll depth on desktop viewports.
3d_and_motion.mobile_fallback: High-resolution static WebP architectural render with subtle CSS subtle parallax shift and floating SVG blueprint grid lines

motion_patterns.on_load_headline: Kinetic line-by-line masked slide-up reveal (stagger 0.15s, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1))
motion_patterns.marquee: Slow editorial text drift (react-fast-marquee or CSS keyframe over 35s speed, warm stone background, dark copper text)
motion_patterns.scroll_reveals: Framer motion viewport enter opacity: [0, 1], y: [30, 0] with once: true

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, filters, tabs, menu triggers) and key metrics include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='project-filter-completed')
Do NOT create or modify .tsx files. Use standard React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components.
Implement Lenis smooth momentum scrolling across marketing pages for a high-end luxury feel.
Ensure header navigation has a solid or heavy frosted backdrop-blur background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F7F5F0]/85 or bg-[#171A1C]/90). NEVER use full transparency under text.
Customize Shadcn components with custom Tailwind rules matching the architectural stone, graphite, and bronze accent aesthetic.
Ensure sonner is used for toast notifications in contact form submissions and admin dashboard actions.
